title: Debug: CRC-8
constraints: CRC-8 with polynomial x⁸ + x² + x + 1 (0x07), initial value 0x00, no reflection, no final XOR (CRC-8/SMBUS).
Each rising edge with `valid` processes one whole byte, MSB first. `init` (priority over `valid`) and the synchronous reset set the CRC to 0x00.
`crc` is the register value. For example the bytes of the ASCII string "123456789" give 0xF4.
hints: Compute the check value of "123456789" by hand (or trust 0xF4) and compare the bit order.
What happens when `init` and `valid` are asserted on the same edge (the first byte of a new packet)?
